rule: Fill-path only. Stamp name= stays catalog official_field_key (TIN/branch). Unstamped leftover writer keys may be copied onto the existing cell-id name= when the freeze sheet has exactly one fillable under a printed caption that matches one leftover-unique fields.json key, and the identity catalog names that cell as html_id_hint. That is not an official_field_key harvest. Text joins ASCII-uppercase letters into comb slots and data-writer-value for BIR CAPITAL LETTERS print; digits and punctuation are unchanged. Do not mutate profile/DB values. R3 peso+cent tax rows may be listed in money_joins: one leftover money key maps to peso_html_id plus cent_html_id. Split the writer {:.2} string: pesos right-aligned in the peso comb (leading slots empty, not zero-padded, no decimal glyph), cents in the 2-slot comb. Do not stamp name= on either comb. Do not left-align the dotted string into the peso comb. Leftover boolean/radio keys may be listed in xbox_joins: when the writer is true, put X in the catalog xbox (1-char text, not type=checkbox). Do not write the string true into the box. Do not join leftover keys that share an item number with another leftover except as documented here (For the Month MM/YYYY pair; Amended Return and Any Taxes Withheld Yes/No pairs). Since #113: every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason. One writer key may fill several cells (html_ids). Part II items 15-36 follow the same peso+cent contract as items 14 and 25. date_joins split one writer date (MM/DD/YYYY or MM/YYYY) across separate MM, DD and YYYY combs (Part III dates, Schedule I). Print-only derived: keys come from Form1601CDraft::to_print_field_map: the page-2 TIN comb (derived:tin_digits), Item 9 over its two lines and Item 13A.
